design.population: unique works in frozen retrieval-v1 manifest after Top50 calibration exclusion

randomization.algorithm: SHA-256 UTF-8 with NUL separators; lexicographic digest order; canonical_work_id tie-break

calibration_exclusion.rule: exclude any work matching a Top50 seed by normalized DOI, arXiv identity, ISBN identity when available, or conservative normalized title+publication-year equality

claim_sampling.selection: retain all when <=3; otherwise deterministic SHA-256 rank using work_id + source_locator + exact_source_span_digest

diagnostics.year: retain publication year; any report bands must be frozen from pre-outcome bibliographic metadata
diagnostics.field_topic: diagnostic/balance/sensitivity only; never a hard eligibility criterion in v1

precision.note: normal/binomial-style references only; clustered literature is not IID

null_schedule.method: deterministic SHA-256-ranked single-cycle target rotation per permutation index

freeze_state.authorization_condition: freeze precision/cost tradeoff using basis-blind operational data before any held-out decomposition outcome is inspected
